mapper.select: SELECT id, application_no, applicant_id, employee_id, target_department_id, use_type, purpose, start_at, due_at, return_required, status, current_node, submitted_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM archive_access_application WHERE id = #{id} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND target_department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) )
SELECT id, application_id, archive_document_id, archive_version_id, scope FROM archive_access_item WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id, application_id, node_code, approver_id, decision, comment, decided_at FROM archive_access_approval WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY id

SELECT u.id, u.application_id, u.receiver_id, u.checked_out_at, u.due_at, u.returned_at, u.return_type, u.handover_to_id, u.missing_description, u.damage_description, u.status, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM archive_use_record u JOIN archive_access_application a ON a.id = u.application_id WHERE u.application_id = #{applicationId} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND a.target_department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND a.employee_id = #{employeeId}) )
